versions.summary: Production catch-up promotion from r20260911-42f2f11 to main cd80096b: Hermes review-chain fixes, engineer Slack outbound kill switch, Slack summons reformat, admin/release-notes consoles, and enablement manual-flow fixes.

sections.title: Notes
items: Major version bump: this is a whole-train promotion of merged main (PRs #1126 through #1180 lineage), not a single-feature release.
Machine-readable deployment records (release id, commit, image digests, included PRs, deploy time) are read live from the Production database in the Deployment records view.

sections.title: Included capabilities
items: Engineer Slack outbound kill switch (ENGINEER_SLACK_OUTBOUND_ENABLED): Production stops posting to the engineer channel; Preproduction keeps the review summons (p2-150).

Hermes review chain hardened end to end on Preproduction: save_reply_draft endpoint fix, publication gate wiring, guardrail readiness derivation, Slack root+thread review summons with investigation summary, human approve to Zendesk delivery (p2-148).
Enablement reverted to the manual review flow with reply-first gated email and five review-round fixes (p2-149, includes hotfix r20260911-42f2f11 lineage superseded by main).
ECS Admin read-only console and versioned release notes (p2-151/p2-153/p2-155); workspace admin console switch with deployments live view.
Hermes/Memory public UI dashboards behind auth (p2-154 follow-up infra); Slack summons formatting tweaks (route result label, body-only thread replies).
Workflow hardening: task worktree cleanup split out of finalize to prevent the ZCode shell cwd failure.

versions.summary: Baseline: SupportPortal automation running on ECS Production at release r20260911-42f2f11.

sections.title: Notes
items: Version 1.0.0 is the baseline assigned to the current Production release; earlier history is not versioned.
Machine-readable deployment records (release id, commit, image digests, included PRs, deploy time) are read live from the Production database in the Deployment records view.

sections.title: Included capabilities
items: Account case automation (Fraud Account, Account Suspension, Detailed Invoice, Enablement, Quota) on ECS Production with routed Persona replies.
Engineer Slack collaboration loop with Hermes investigation review, thread-bound summons, and publication gates.
Ticket-centric read-only dashboard and Admin console under /automation/production/.
CodeBuild release pipeline with immutable images, prompt-release gates, and deploy-time release-note records.
